title: Ex-Change Parts appointed authorized partner of Airbus Helicopters
summary: Approval by the manufacturer and access to a wider range of helicopter parts gives a strong reassurance for existing and new clients.
body_markdown:
Ex-Change Parts AB, a provider of aftermarket products and services to helicopter owners, operators and MROs, announced today its appointment as an Authorized Partner of Airbus Helicopters.


Approval by the manufacturer and access to a wider range of helicopter parts gives a strong reassurance for both existing and new clients.


The appointment as an Authorized Partner of Airbus Helicopters reinforces Ex-Change Parts’ market strength and commitment to the full product line of Airbus Helicopters.


The substantially increased collaboration between the two companies opens many new opportunities to their respective customers with a wider range of parts.


Ex-Change Parts prides itself in its commitment to excellence and professionalism, and this approach has made them a trusted partner for operators around the world.


The company’s provision of both helicopter parts supply and technical support helps reduce downtime and supports operators’ need to get aircraft back in the air at the earliest opportunity.


The Ex-Change Parts extensive inventory of line items will be promoted through the Airbus online marketplace AirbusWorld. At the same time, the company becomes an Authorized Partner and reseller of Airbus Helicopters’ inventory of both reconditioned and surplus parts.


Ex-Change Parts will also become an approved reseller of pre-owned helicopters from the Airbus Helicopters Trade-In program, including both serviceable and non-serviceable airframes from both Airbus and other manufacturers.


Ex-Change Parts Photo


The agreement also grants Ex-Change Parts the right to supply Airbus products and services to civil, private and military helicopter owners, operators, and MRO organizations worldwide.


This appointment follows a thorough multi-day validation and approval process by Airbus Helicopters on site at Ex-Change Parts facilities in Sweden. The company has over 27 years of industry experience, and facilities including a 80,000-plus line items. a 4,000m² warehouse and two hangars, and a commitment to quality reflected in their ISO 9001:2015 and ASA-100 accreditations.


Rikard Jansson, CEO of Ex-Change Parts, said: “We have been privileged to support Airbus Helicopters France as an approved supplier for a number of years. Transitioning to the status of Official Reseller is a testament to the strength of our collaboration. It is a significant milestone that builds on our shared history and creates new opportunities for growth as well as value for our common customers.


Göran Enström, head of business development for Ex-Change Parts, added: “We are delighted to be recognized by Airbus Helicopters for the commitment we have made to their brand over many years. The new agreement brings the two organizations closer and we expect our mutual customers to be the beneficiaries of his new agreement”


Ex-Change Parts continues to look ahead to expansion opportunities.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Ex-Change Parts.*
